evidence.field: file description, source and reuse terms
evidence.text: Commons describes 父-oracle.svg as a digital vector drawing in Shang oracle script style. It points to Sinica Database image 41.EEDF as the specific source and states that the drawing and source image are CC0 1.0/public domain. This is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:父-oracle.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.field: file description, source and reuse terms
evidence.text: Commons describes 巴-oracle.svg as a digital vector drawing in Shang oracle script style, based on Richard Sears Chinese Etymology image J30397. It records Sears courtesy, permission and copyright language under the Sears agreement while labeling the representation public domain. This is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph; the file page itself says its period needs clarification.
evidence.title: File:巴-oracle.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.field: file description, source and reuse terms
evidence.text: Commons describes 父-seal.svg as a modern vector drawing in Shuowen seal-script style based on Richard Sears image s02164. It records Sears courtesy, permission and copyright language under the Sears agreement and also labels the representation public domain. This is a redraw, not an excavated seal impression.
evidence.title: File:父-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The Commons pages expose the direct image links for 父-oracle.svg, 巴-oracle.svg, and 父-seal.svg. Opening those links through the web tool failed: 父-oracle returned cache miss; the other two returned unsupported SVG content-type errors. The links were obtained from the inspected page controls, not guessed. The images were not visually inspected.
evidence.title: File:父-oracle.svg - Wikimedia Commons

search_audit.query: Open Wikimedia Commons source pages for 父-oracle.svg, 巴-oracle.svg and 父-seal.svg; inspect descriptions, direct original-file links, sources and reuse terms
search_audit.outcome: Opened all three Commons description pages and verified their script-style labels, image sources, reuse language and direct original-file controls.

search_audit.query: Follow the direct original-file controls shown on the three inspected Commons pages
search_audit.outcome: Retrieval failed in the web tool: 父-oracle returned cache miss; 巴-oracle and 父-seal returned unsupported SVG content-type errors. These are page-exposed links. No candidate was visually inspected.

gaps: No glyph for 爸 itself is represented by these candidates. They show its separately analyzed components 父 and 巴 and must not be presented as earlier stages in 爸’s graphic history.
The candidates are modern vector redrawings in ancient-script styles, not photographs or facsimiles of dated artifacts. Commons flags the precise period for 巴-oracle as needing clarification.
Original image bytes could not be retrieved by the web tool, so their pixels were not visually inspected. The harness or visual reviewer should confirm rendered forms before use.

The two Sears-sourced candidates have page language referring to courtesy, permission and copyright under the Sears agreement alongside a public-domain label; retain source attribution and follow that agreement when reusing.

items.period: Shang oracle-script style (Commons notes precise period needs clarification)
items.tradition: Chinese oracle script; modern vector redraw
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 巴 in an oracle-script style, based on Richard Sears Chinese Etymology image J30397. 巴 is the phonetic component identified in 爸; the depicted form does not establish the sound or name of any object associated with 巴.
items.alt: A black line-drawn oracle-script-style form of 巴 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Useful alongside 父 to represent both proposed components of 爸. Commons identifies the source drawing and reuse notes, while explicitly leaving precise period unclear.
items.rights: Commons labels the drawing public domain and also records Sears courtesy, permission and copyright under its agreement; preserve attribution and follow the agreement.

items.caption: Modern redraw of 父 in Shuowen seal-script style, based on Richard Sears image s02164. This later script-style comparison illustrates 父 as a component, not a documented stage in the graphic history of 爸.
items.alt: A black line-drawn seal-script-style form of 父 on a plain background.
items.selection_reason: Pairs with the oracle-style 父 candidate to show a distinct script-style rendering of the semantic component. Commons provides specific source and reuse notes.

limitations.text: No candidate depicts an attested early form of 爸. The images illustrate components only. All are modern vector redrawings, and their pixels were not inspected in this research pass because the web tool could not retrieve the SVGs.

The 巴 oracle-style file is labeled Shang oracle script style, but Commons flags the precise period as needing clarification. Its Sears-related reuse language should be followed despite the accompanying public-domain label.
